# Error codes

<!-- GENERATED by backend/tools/gen-integration-skill from
     backend/gateway-service/internal/service/operator/softswiss/codes.go.
     Do not edit: `make sdk-skill` regenerates it and CI fails on a diff. -->

Every error on this contract is the same envelope. Only two HTTP statuses
exist — **400** and **500** — and only two `code` values, `invalid_argument`
and `internal`. The meaning is in `meta.api_code`. **Branch on `api_code`,
never on the HTTP status.**

```json
{
  "code": "invalid_argument",
  "msg": "insufficient funds",
  "meta": { "api_code": "100", "api_message": "insufficient funds", "balance": "50.00" }
}
```

## Balance is mandatory for three codes

`100`, `105` and `106` MUST carry `meta.balance`. The platform reads that
field with the error swallowed, so omitting it does not fail — the player
just sees a wrong balance. The SDKs make it a required argument of those
three constructors for exactly that reason.

## The registry

| api_code | Constant | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `100` | `APICodeInsufficientFunds` | Player has not enough funds to process an action |
| `101` | `APICodeInvalidPlayer` | Player is invalid |
| `105` | `APICodeBetLimitReached` | Player reached customized bet limit |
| `106` | `APICodeMaxBetExceeded` | Bet exceeded max bet limit |
| `107` | `APICodeGameForbidden` | Game is forbidden to the player |
| `110` | `APICodePlayerDisabled` | Player is disabled |
| `153` | `APICodeCountryRestricted` | Game is not available in Player's country |
| `154` | `APICodeCurrencyNotAllowed` | Currency is not allowed for the player |
| `155` | `APICodeFieldImmutable` | Forbidden to change already set field |
| `400` | `APICodeBadRequest` | Bad request (invalid JSON, validation error) |
| `403` | `APICodeForbidden` | Forbidden (signature mismatch) |
| `404` | `APICodeNotFound` | Not found |
| `405` | `APICodeGameNotAvailable` | Game is not available to your casino |
| `406` | `APICodeFreespinsNotAvailable` | Freespins are not available for your casino |
| `409` | `APICodeTombstoned` | Action already rolled back (tombstoned) |
| `410` | `APICodeCasinoDisabled` | Casino is disabled |
| `411` | `APICodeEndpointDisabledCasino` | This endpoint is disabled in the casino configuration |
| `420` | `APICodeEndpointDisabledProvider` | This endpoint is disabled in the provider configuration |

| `700` | `APICodeLiveGameUnavailable` | Requested live game is not available right now |

## Which of these do you return?

As an operator serving the wallet callbacks you will realistically return:
`100` (no funds), `101` (unknown player), `105`/`106` (limits), `110`
(player disabled), `400` (bad request), `403` (bad signature), `409`
(already rolled back) and `500` (your side failed — the platform will retry).
The rest describe platform-side conditions you receive rather than send.
